limitations: Zero matches means not-proven alignment, not no interaction.

E1.nextPrerequisite: Restore client call evidence first; then run bounded, local-only candidate clustering over existing endpoint and reverse reports using opaque identities.

E2.name: razor-binding-inventory
limitations: Current artifacts provide gap diagnostics, not a complete Razor binding inventory.

E3.name: legacy-event-patterns
limitations: The observed rule identifies WinForms gaps and cannot be relabeled as WebForms evidence.

Compilation/configuration noise is not proof of application defects.
E4.nextPrerequisite: Produce anonymous per-scope readiness categories before any Angular parity work.
